results.relation_rationale: The reported primary endpoint is the adjudicated composite of cardiovascular death or hospitalization for heart failure, analyzed as time to first event, and the randomized empagliflozin-versus-placebo comparison is the requested comparison. The trial population was chronic HF with LVEF ≤40%, consistent with the requested HFrEF trial population; no fixed-duration risk is substituted for the time-to-event estimate.
